title: USF Observability Signal Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for observability signal definitions (logs, metrics, traces, spans, runtime events, runtime proof outputs, service/resource attributes, correlation identifiers). Each declares its kind (observability-signal-kinds), name, source, and purpose, mapped to a semantic contract and to proof/evidence where applicable. Observability is a semantic asset: removing or renaming a signal requires semantic review, not an incidental refactor. USF claims no full OpenTelemetry compliance until concrete attribute schemas exist. Governs the ontology concept Observability Signal. lifecycleState draft; not active.
